I have written M4 in 1 public repository, from 2019 to 2019.

What it was for: [Media and art](@/projects/media.md) (1).

Most recently: [dj-schnapps](@/work/dj-schnapps.md): Dj Schnapps.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses M4: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links M4 to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
